annotations.title: Pre-Payment HTTP 402 (L402 / x402 / MPP) Invoice & Macaroon Fraud Verifier

description: Decodes inbound HTTP 402 Payment Required challenges (L402 BOLT11 + Macaroon, x402 Solana Native SOL, MPP Base intents) to verify cryptographic payment-hash binding and block overcharge fraud. Use when auditing a 402 challenge header before an autonomous agent pays a Lightning invoice or USDC transfer; for checking on-chain Bitcoin L1 mempool feerates, use estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'www_authenticate' ('protocol_hint' defaults to 'L402'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (60 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

protocol_hint.description: Expected HTTP 402 payment protocol; defaults to 'L402' when omitted.

www_authenticate.description: Raw WWW-Authenticate or Payment-Required HTTP header string from a 402 response.

name: verify_http402_payment_challenge

macaroon_payment_hash_matches_bolt11.description: True when the macaroon caveat hash matches the BOLT11 invoice payment hash.

overcharge_detected.description: True if the invoice amount exceeds the declared endpoint price ceiling.
